emily: Quick post-all-hands follow-up. We covered runtime roadmap but Ops/Docs/PM need a tight checklist for the kernel-v11 canary and batching defaults so customer guidance can land. Two asks: 1) What specific metrics/alerts should we watch during canary? 2) One-line default + tenant-override YAML we can paste in docs. Keep replies terse please. @sam @raj @kevin
sam: Metrics to watch: kernel_error_rate, p50/p95/p99 token latency, kv_evictions/sec, gpu_util, batch_queue_time_ms, cold_start_rate. Alerts: kernel_error_rate >0.5% sustained 5m, p95 > 250ms spike 3m.
raj: For Dedicated prewarm: watch prewarm_miss_rate and prewarm_pool_util. Recommend prewarm_size = max(2, floor(req_rate * 0.1)). Hosted default eviction = LRU.
kevin: Rollback steps are in the playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/kernel-release. CI gate: perf-suite green + smoke tests pass. I'll add an automated rollout abort if kernel_error_rate > 1% within first 15m.
zoe: I'll produce a tiny CSV with p50/p95/p99 + approximate cost delta for batch_ms buckets (5/10/15/25). ETA Thu morning, will attach to DOC ticket.
dina: Created DOC-9012 to track docs + PM table. Owner: Dina.
sam: Paste-ready YAML for docs (conservative defaults):
```
runtime_defaults:
  batching:
    batch_ms: 10
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
    adaptive: true
  kv_cache:
    policy: LRU
    ttl_seconds: 0  # tenant may set >0 to enable time-first eviction
  prewarm:
    enabled: false
    target_concurrency: 2
  canary_guardrails:
    error_rate_threshold_pct: 1.0
    initial_traffic_pct: 5
```
emily: Perfect. Can someone post a one-line summary I can paste into the all-hands notes with owners+ETA? One sentence per item.
sam: "Kernel-canary guardrails: metrics + abort rules set (Sam/Keven) EOD; Hosted defaults: batch_ms=10, KV=LRU (Sam) EOD; Cost/perf CSV (Zoe) Thu AM; Docs ticket DOC-9012 (Dina) Wed."
kevin: small correction: please read my name as Kevin not Keven ;)
